Load prevalent new-user study data from a database

Source: R/DataLoadingSaving.R
getDbPnuData.Rd

Executes the exposure-set and cohort SQL against the CDM, calls FeatureExtraction to collect covariates, queries the outcome cohort, and returns a [PnuData] object containing all tables needed for downstream analysis.

Usage

getDbPnuData(
  connection,
  cdmDatabaseSchema,
  cohortDatabaseSchema,
  cohortTable,
  pnuCohortArgs,
  covariateSettings,
  tempEmulationSchema = NULL,
  exposureSetDefinition = "time",
  restrictToCommonPeriod = FALSE
)

Arguments

connection

A `DatabaseConnector` connection object.

cdmDatabaseSchema

Schema containing the OMOP CDM tables.

cohortDatabaseSchema

Schema containing `cohortTable`.

cohortTable

Name of the cohort table (without schema prefix).

pnuCohortArgs

A [PnuCohortArgs] settings object created by [createPnuCohortArgs()].

covariateSettings

A covariate settings object created by `FeatureExtraction::createCovariateSettings()` or similar.

tempEmulationSchema

Schema for temp-table emulation on databases that do not support native temp tables. Pass `NULL` on supported databases.

exposureSetDefinition

`"time"` (days on treatment A) or `"fills"` (number of treatment-A eras). Default: `"time"`.

restrictToCommonPeriod

Not yet implemented; reserved for future use.

Value

A [PnuData] object.

References

Suissa S, Moodie EE, Dell'Aniello S. Prevalent new-user cohort designs for comparative drug effect studies by time-conditional propensity scores. *Pharmacoepidemiol Drug Saf* 2017;26(4):459-468. doi:10.1002/pds.4117

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
connectionDetails <- DatabaseConnector::createConnectionDetails(
  dbms = "sqlite", server = ":memory:"
)
conn <- DatabaseConnector::connect(connectionDetails)
pnuData <- getDbPnuData(
  connection           = conn,
  cdmDatabaseSchema    = "main",
  cohortDatabaseSchema = "main",
  cohortTable          = "cohort",
  pnuCohortArgs        = createPnuCohortArgs(
    targetCohortId = 1L, comparatorCohortId = 2L, outcomeCohortId = 3L
  ),
  covariateSettings    = FeatureExtraction::createDefaultCovariateSettings()
)
DatabaseConnector::disconnect(conn)
} # }
